Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://kannur.dcourts.gov.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 11-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Court Attender post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Court Attender post at District Court Thalassery is 11th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Court Attender position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Court Attender post in the District Court Thalassery recruitment drive. This provides a limited but significant opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Court Attender role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Court Attender position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 23,360. This is a fixed consolidated salary for the contract period.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the District Court Thalassery Court Attender recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Court Attender post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Court Attender post primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on the verification of their submitted documents.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Court Attender recruitment at District Court Thalassery. This makes the application process more accessible.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Court Attender position at District Court Thalassery is a contract-based job. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions of the contract.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the District Court Thalassery located?
faq.answer: The District Court Thalassery is located in Thalassery, Kerala, with a pincode of 670101. This information is helpful for candidates to understand the work location.

faq.answer: The provided data does not specify the exact educational qualifications. Candidates are strongly advised to refer to the official notification PDF for detailed eligibility criteria, including minimum educational requirements.
